Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within processing of the BackupAssociationServlet servlet in the SolarWinds Storage Manager Web Services web server. The parameter valDB is vulnerable to SQL injection when the state parameter is set to delete. This allows an attacker to run arbitrary code as SYSTEM.
